# Looping animated GIFs from GPT Image 2.6 — mascots, logos and prompts

**A still, mascot, logo or prompt becomes a looping GPT Image 2.6 GIF sized to the frame budget, then WebP and MP4 for the web.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_517f33c08e84.webp" alt="Two looping GIFs made with GPT Image 2.6: an origami paper boat rocking on a moonlit sea, then a cartoon fox mascot in a scarf waving." width="480"></p>

Turn a still, mascot, logo or a plain prompt into a looping animated GIF with GPT Image 2.6 on varg (output_format gif): the sprite-sheet pixel budget with a measured table of frame sizes that fit 2, 4, 6, 9, 12 and 16 frames, the approve-a-still-first workflow, loop-lock prompt wording, frame_duration_ms, transparent backgrounds, the failure modes (text in frames, fast motion, boiling backgrounds) and post-processing to animated WebP and MP4 with scripts/gif2web.sh. Use when someone asks for a GIF, an animated mascot or logo, a looping wave, blink or bounce, a reaction GIF, "animate this image" as a GIF, or a GIF that was rejected or came back broken. Not for sticker packs per messenger (gpt-image-sticker-pack), game sprite sheets and atlases (gpt-image-sprite-sheet) or real video clips (varg-ai, kling-4-prompting).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill gpt-image-gif                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills gpt-image-gif --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Animate my mascot ./pip.png waving and hopping as a looping GIF with a transparent background"
- "Make a 9-frame looping GIF of a paper boat on a night sea, then convert it to WebP and MP4"
- "My 12-frame GIF request at 1024×1024 was rejected. Pick a size that fits and run it again"
